'''2022 MPC Justin Desai LS Old Allies''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Justin Desai]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Old Allies / We Need Your Help|V4-L-oldallies.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Old Allies Desai LS 2022 MPC.txt |Download]]
